entities.description: A planeswalker and mind-mage who can create illusions without having met the original creature.

events.summary: Jace Beleren is said to be able to create illusions without having met the creature they depict.
events.quote: Jace Beleren doesn't have to have met a particular illusion in order to create one

events.summary: Even proficient mind-mages like Jace are said to have limited range, so learning a summoning requires planeswalking to the plane.
events.quote: Even proficient mind-mages like Jace have a limited range for their mind-detecting abilities

relations.note: The woolly thoctar is a creature native to Naya.
Naya is a part of Alara.
relations.quote: you can summon a woolly thoctar while on a plane other than Alara
